title: Future Continuous o Future Perfect
instructions: Completá con will be + -ing (en progreso) o will have + participio (completado antes de un momento futuro).
text:
1. This time tomorrow, I [1] (fly) over the Atlantic.
2. Don't call at 8. We [2] (have) dinner.
3. Next week, they [3] (test) the new system.
4. By 2030, she [4] (finish) her degree in AI.
5. They [5] (sign) the contract by the end of the day.
6. By the time you get there, we [6] (already / leave).
7. This time next year, they [7] (work) in their new office.
8. Can I call at 5:30? — Better not, I [8] (do) my homework then.
9. Better not, I [9] (do) my homework by then.

pat: el Future Continuous es will be + -ing: will be flying.
This time tomorrow es un momento en que la acción está en progreso: Future Continuous, will be flying.
items.e: 'This time tomorrow' → en progreso: will + be + -ing.

pat: el Future Continuous es will be + -ing: will be having.
Don't call at 8 = a esa hora estarán cenando (en progreso): will be having.
items.e: 'at 8' → acción en progreso en ese momento.

pat: el Future Continuous es will be + -ing: will be testing.
Next week sin un plazo ('by') describe una acción en progreso: will be testing.
items.e: Acción en progreso durante un período futuro.

pat: el Future Perfect es will have + participio: will have finished.
By 2030 marca un plazo: la acción estará terminada → Future Perfect, will have finished.
items.e: 'By 2030' → completado antes de ese momento: will + have + participio.

pat: by the end of the day marca un plazo: terminada para entonces → will have signed.
el Future Perfect es will have + participio: will have signed.
items.e: 'by the end of the day' → Future Perfect.

pat: ^will have already went$|^will have already leave$
el participio de leave es left (leave → left → left): will have already left.
By the time you get there marca un plazo: Future Perfect, will have already left.
items.e: By the time → Future Perfect; left es el participio de leave.

pat: This time next year es un momento en que la acción está en progreso: will be working.
el Future Continuous es will be + -ing: will be working.
then (a esa hora) la acción está en progreso: will be doing.
el Future Continuous es will be + -ing: will be doing.
items.e: 'then' = en ese momento → la tarea sigue en progreso.

pat: by then marca un plazo: para entonces estará terminada → will have done.
el Future Perfect es will have + participio: will have done.
items.e: 'by then' = para ese momento → ya terminada.

title: then vs by then: Future Continuous o Future Perfect
instructions: Elegí la opción correcta. 'then' → en progreso; 'by then' → ya completado.

items.q: Don't call me at 3. I ___ the presentation.

will have given: at 3 es un momento exacto en que la acción está en progreso: will be giving. will have given sería ya terminada.
give: falta el futuro; en progreso a esa hora: will be giving.
gave: pasado; la frase habla del futuro (at 3): will be giving.

items.q: By 3 o'clock, I ___ the presentation, so call me after that.

will be giving: By 3 o'clock marca un plazo: para esa hora ya la habré dado → will have given.
will give: will give no dice que estará terminada para las 3; con By + plazo: will have given.
give: falta el futuro; con By + plazo: will have given.

items.q: This time next week, we ___ on the beach.

will have lain: This time next week es un momento exacto con la acción en progreso: will be lying.
are lying: el Present Continuous sería un arreglo o algo que pasa ahora; una acción en progreso en un momento futuro: will be lying.
lay: pasado; la frase habla del futuro: will be lying.

items.q: By next Friday, the team ___ the migration.

will be finishing: By next Friday marca un plazo: ya estará terminada → will have finished.
finishes: el presente simple es para horarios; con By + plazo: will have finished.
will finishing: el Future Perfect es will have + participio: will have finished.

items.q: Don't call Luke — he ___ his homework now.
items.e: Suposición sobre algo que pasa ahora (Unit3/02 d).

will have done: now/Don't call = ahora mismo estará haciéndolo (en progreso): will be doing.
will do: will do es una acción futura simple; acá la acción está en progreso: will be doing.
does: el presente simple no marca algo en progreso; con la idea de 'va a estar haciendo': will be doing.

items.q: I ___ all afternoon, so I can't meet you.

will have worked: all afternoon es una duración en progreso, no un plazo: will be working.
will work: will work no marca la duración continua de toda la tarde: will be working.
work: falta el futuro; duración en progreso: will be working.

items.q: By the end of this course, you ___ over 500 new words.
items.e: By the end of → resultado acumulado.

will be learning: By the end of this course marca un plazo: el resultado ya estará logrado → will have learned.
will learn: will learn no dice que el resultado estará logrado para entonces; con By + plazo: will have learned.
learn: falta el futuro; con By + plazo: will have learned.

items.q: I can't wait for Friday! We ___ our exams by then.
items.e: Ejemplo de tu apunte: by then → completado.

will be finishing: by then marca un plazo: ya habremos terminado → will have finished.
will finish: will finish no dice que estará terminado para entonces; con by then: will have finished.
finish: falta el futuro; con by then: will have finished.

title: ¿Cuál oración es correcta? (Future Continuous y Perfect)

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

Future Continuous es will be + -ing; have va con participio: I'll be writing.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: By then, I'll be finished my homework.
By then, I'll have finished my homework.
By then, I'll finishing my homework.
items.a: By then, I'll have finished my homework.

By then marca un plazo; el Future Perfect es will have + participio: I'll have finished.
falta have + participio: I'll have finished.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I will have do it tomorrow.
I will be do it tomorrow.
items.e: Sin referencia 'antes de un momento futuro' → no es Future Perfect.

will have va con participio (done); y para algo simple de mañana: will do.
will be va con -ing; para algo simple de mañana: will do.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: Will you be writing your CV?
Are you will be writing your CV?
items.a: Will you be writing your CV?

Will you writing your CV?: falta be: Will you be writing?
Are you will be writing your CV?: doble auxiliar; la pregunta es Will you be writing?

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: I won't have finished by then.
I won't have finish by then.
items.a: I won't have finished by then.

después de won't va el verbo base; con by then el Future Perfect es won't have finished.
won't have va con participio: finished.

title: Future time clauses: nunca will
instructions: Completá con la forma correcta del verbo entre paréntesis. Ojo con qué va después de when / until / as soon as...
text:
1. I'll send the report to the client as soon as I [1] (finish) it.
2. We won't leave until the meeting [2] (be) over.
3. Call me when you [3] (arrive) at the hotel.
4. Before she [4] (arrive), let's prepare the room.
5. When I [5] (see) them, I'll talk to them about it.
6. By the time you [6] (get) there, we'll have left.
7. OK, I [7] (call) you back when I finish this task.
8. Once the client [8] (approve) the design, we'll start development.
9. While you [9] (present), I'll be setting up the demo.
10. As soon as it [10] (be) ready, we'll deploy.

pat: después de as soon as no va will; se usa presente simple: finish.
items.e: as soon as → Present Simple o Present Perfect, nunca will.

pat: después de until no va will; se usa presente simple: is.
the meeting es 3.ª persona singular: is.
items.e: until → Present Simple: until the meeting IS over (no will be).

pat: después de when no va will; se usa presente simple: arrive.
después de before no va will; se usa presente simple: arrives.
después de when no va will; se usa presente simple: see.
items.e: Ejemplo de tu apunte: When we see them, we'll talk.

pat: después de by the time no va will; se usa presente simple: get.
items.e: By the time + Present Simple/Perfect; principal en Future Perfect.

pat: una promesa/decisión del momento (OK, I...) se dice con will: will call.
falta will para la promesa: will call.
items.e: Promesa/decisión en el momento → will en la cláusula PRINCIPAL.

pat: después de once no va will; se usa presente simple: approves.
the client es 3.ª persona singular: approves (con -s).
items.e: Once + Present Simple/Perfect; the client → approves.

pat: después de while no va will; se usa presente simple: present.
items.e: While + Present (Simple o Continuous), nunca will.

pat: después de as soon as no va will; se usa presente simple: is.
items.e: Tu apunte: As soon as it IS ready (no will be).

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: When I will finish, I'll call you.
When I finish, I'll call you.
When I finishing, I'll call you.
items.a: When I finish, I'll call you.

después de when no va will: When I finish.
falta el verbo conjugado: When I finish.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: As soon as it will be ready, we'll deploy.
As soon as it is ready, we'll deploy.
As soon as it be ready, we'll deploy.
items.a: As soon as it is ready, we'll deploy.

As soon as it will be ready, we'll deplo: después de as soon as no va will: As soon as it is ready.
el verbo debe estar conjugado: it is ready.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: By the time you will arrive, I'll be gone.
By the time you arrive, I'll be gone.
By the time you arrived, I'll be gone.
items.a: By the time you arrive, I'll be gone.

By the time you will arrive, I'll be gon: después de by the time no va will: By the time you arrive.
la frase habla del futuro; en la cláusula de tiempo va presente simple: you arrive.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: By the time she arrives, I'll finish the report.
By the time she arrives, I'll have finished the report.
By the time she arrives, I'll be finished the report.
items.a: By the time she arrives, I'll have finished the report.
items.e: By the time → cláusula principal en Future Perfect.

By the time she arrives, I'll finish the: By the time marca un plazo: para entonces estará terminado → Future Perfect: I'll have finished.
By the time she arrives, I'll be finishe: be finished no lleva objeto así; el Future Perfect es will have + participio: I'll have finished.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: While we will be waiting, let's review the notes.
While we wait, let's review the notes.
While we to wait, let's review the notes.
items.a: While we wait, let's review the notes.
items.e: While + Present (Simple o Continuous), nunca will.

While we will be waiting, let's review t: después de while no va will: While we wait.
While we to wait, let's review the notes: falta el verbo conjugado: While we wait.

items.q: I'll call you as soon as I ___ the results.

will get: después de as soon as no va will; presente simple: get.
am getting: el Present Continuous no se usa acá; después de as soon as va presente simple: get.
got: pasado; la frase habla del futuro (I'll call): presente simple, get.

items.q: By the time the client calls, we ___ the bug.

will fix: By the time marca un plazo: para entonces ya lo habremos arreglado → Future Perfect: will have fixed.
are fixing: are fixing es presente/arreglo; con By the time + plazo: will have fixed.
fixed: pasado; la frase habla del futuro: will have fixed.

items.q: ___ you leave, push your changes.
items.e: Antes de que te vayas → Before.

Until: Until = hasta que; 'hasta que te vayas, hacé push' no tiene sentido. Antes de irte: Before.
Since: Since = desde que; no indica 'antes de irte': Before.
While: While = mientras; no indica 'antes de irte': Before.

items.q: Don't push to main ___ the tests pass.

when: 'no hagas push cuando pasen los tests' dice lo contrario. La idea es 'hasta que pasen': until.
as soon as: as soon as = apenas; daría 'no hagas push apenas pasen los tests': el sentido contrario.
once: once = una vez que; daría el sentido contrario. Hasta que: until.

items.q: ___ you're presenting, I'll be setting up the demo.
items.e: Dos acciones simultáneas → while (+ Future Continuous).

Until: Until = hasta que; las dos acciones son simultáneas (mientras): While.
Before: Before = antes de que; las acciones ocurren a la vez: While.
By the time: By the time marca un plazo; acá son acciones simultáneas: While.

items.q: Next time this ___, I'll know what to do.
items.e: Tu apunte: Next time this happens.

will happen: después de time/when no va will; presente simple: happens.
is happening: el Present Continuous no se usa acá; presente simple: happens.
happened: pasado; la frase habla del futuro: happens.

items.q: I'll wait here until you ___ back.

will come: después de until no va will; presente simple: come.
are coming: el Present Continuous no se usa acá; presente simple: come.
came: pasado; la frase habla del futuro: come.

items.q: ___ the client has approved the design, we'll start development.

While: While = mientras; acá se habla de una acción terminada antes de empezar: Once.
Since: Since = desde que; no marca 'una vez que se aprobó': Once.
During: During es preposición y no va antes de una cláusula con sujeto y verbo: Once.

title: be about to / be due to / be likely to

items.q: The keynote speaker is ___ arrive at any moment, so please be ready to welcome her.
items.e: Inminente ('at any moment') → be about TO + infinitivo.

about: falta to: be about to + verbo.
due: falta to (be due to + verbo); y due no indica algo inminente: about to.
likely: falta to (be likely to + verbo); y likely expresa probabilidad, no inminencia: about to.

items.q: The exam ___ start in ten minutes.
items.e: Programado con horario → be due to.

is about: falta to; y about to = inminente. in ten minutes es un horario programado: is due to.
is unlikely: falta to; y unlikely = poco probable. El examen está programado: is due to.
is going: falta to (is going to start); el ejercicio pide la idea de 'programado': is due to.

items.q: Look! The film ___ start. Everyone is sitting down.

is due: falta to; y due to = programado. La película está por empezar (inminente): is about to.
is likely: falta to; y likely = probable, no inminente: is about to.
is unlikely: falta to; y unlikely = improbable: is about to.

items.q: We ___ win the contract. Our offer is much more expensive than the others.

are likely to: likely = probable; el precio mucho más caro hace improbable ganar: are unlikely to.
are due to: due to = programado; no habla de probabilidad: are unlikely to.
are about to: about to = inminente; no encaja con 'nuestra oferta es más cara': are unlikely to.

items.q: He studies hard every day, so he ___ do well in the exam.

is unlikely to: unlikely = improbable; estudia mucho, así que es probable que le vaya bien: is likely to.
is about: falta to; y about to = inminente: is likely to.
is due: falta to; y due to = programado: is likely to.

items.q: That new platform has received a lot of attention lately. It is ___ become very popular.
items.e: Probabilidad (por la atención reciente) → likely to. 'about to' implicaría que ocurre en minutos.

about: falta to; y about to = inminente: likely to.
about to: about to = inminente; acá se habla de probabilidad: likely to.
unlikely to: unlikely = improbable; la plataforma recibió mucha atención, es probable que se vuelva popular: likely to.

items.q: The new update ___ be released on Monday, according to the calendar.

is about: falta to; y about to = inminente. En el calendario figura el lunes: is due to.
is unlikely: falta to; y unlikely = improbable. Está programado: is due to.
is going: falta to (is going to be); el ejercicio pide la idea de 'programado': is due to.

items.q: She's ___ the exam.
items.e: Después de estas frases va infinitivo, no -ing.

due to passing: después de due to va el verbo base, no -ing: due to pass.
due for pass: la estructura es due to + verbo base, no for: due to pass.

items.q: He's ___ do well.

likely for: la estructura es likely to + verbo base, no for.

items.q: They ___ attend the workshop due to travel issues.

are about to: about to = inminente; los problemas de viaje los hacen improbables: are unlikely to.
are due to: due to = programado; los problemas de viaje indican que NO es probable que asistan: are unlikely to.
will to: después de will no va to: will attend. Y el ejercicio pide la idea de improbable: are unlikely to.

title: Completá con la frase de futuro
instructions: Escribí la frase (about to / due to / likely to / unlikely to) que corresponde.
text:
1. Hurry up! The train is [1] leave.
2. The exam is [2] start in ten minutes.
3. We are [3] win. Our competitor is much better.
4. She is [4] pass the exam. She has studied for months.
5. The report is [5] be published on Friday.

pat: due to = programado. Hurry up! indica algo inminente: about to.
about to = inminente. in ten minutes es un horario programado: due to.
items.e: Programado ('in ten minutes' con horario) → due to.

pat: likely to = probable; el competidor es mucho mejor, así que ganar es improbable: unlikely to.
unlikely to = improbable; estudió meses, es probable que apruebe: likely to.
about to = inminente. El informe está programado para el viernes: due to.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: She's due to passing the exam.
She's due to pass the exam.
items.a: She's due to pass the exam.

después de due to va el verbo base: due to pass.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:

después de likely to va el verbo base: do.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: She's likely to pass the exam.
She likely to pass the exam.
items.a: She's likely to pass the exam.
items.e: Tu apunte: be likely to + infinitivo.

falta to y el verbo base: likely to pass.
falta el verbo be: She's likely to pass.

items.q: Elegí la correcta:
o: The exam is about to start.
items.a: The exam is about to start.

la estructura es be about to + verbo base: about to start.
